targetReport.title: Monthly Labour Survey (毎月勤労統計調査 / Maitsuki Kinrō Tōkei Chōsa)
targetReport.publisher: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW)
targetReport.description: Monthly establishment survey of employment, wages (cash earnings, scheduled and non-scheduled), and hours worked for establishments with 5 or more employees (national and prefectural surveys) plus an annual special survey for smaller establishments. Produces the official wage and hours series used for real-wage calculations and labour-cost analysis.
targetReport._notes: Fundamental statistics (毎月勤労統計). Key source for nominal and real wage growth (the latter using CPI). Widely cited in BOJ Outlook reports, Cabinet Office economic assessments, and spring wage-negotiation analysis. National survey + local survey + special survey structure. June 2026 real wages showed continued positive growth driven by base pay and bonuses.

targetReport.title: Family Income and Expenditure Survey (家計調査 / Kakei Chōsa)
targetReport.description: Monthly survey of household income, expenditure, savings and debt for two-or-more-person households (and separately for one-person and total households). Provides detailed consumption structure data used for CPI weights, national accounts private consumption estimates, and living-standards analysis.
targetReport._notes: Fundamental statistics. Core input into CPI basket weights and into the expenditure-side estimates of GDP. June 2026 real consumption expenditures for two-or-more-person households: −3.3% year-on-year. Complements the quinquennial National Survey of Family Income, Consumption and Wealth.

targetReport.title: Services Producer Price Index (SPPI) / 企業向けサービス価格指数
targetReport.description: Monthly index measuring price changes of services traded among corporations. Complements the Corporate Goods Price Index (CGPI) on the services side and is used in national-accounts deflation of intermediate consumption of services and in analysis of service-sector inflation.
targetReport._notes: BOJ producer-price family member. Continuously cited together with CGPI and CPI in monetary-policy and national-accounts contexts. Provides the services counterpart to goods producer prices and is essential for comprehensive producer-price analysis in a service-dominated economy.

targetReport.title: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS) / National Statistics system
targetReport.publisher: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, Executive Yuan
targetReport.description: Central authority for official statistics in Taiwan. Oversees the national statistical system, produces major economic and social statistics, maintains statistical standards and classifications, and coordinates BAS units across government.
targetReport._notes: Institutional core node. Equivalent to Japan’s Statistics Bureau / MIC and Korea’s KOSTAT. Disseminates via National Statistics portal and related platforms.
targetReport._cadence_evidence: eng.stat.gov.tw is the DGBAS dissemination portal itself, not a titled periodical: the homepage carries a rolling stream of press releases (GDP, earnings, price indices, labour force all dated August 2026) plus query systems and an advance release calendar; no single cadence applies to the site.
targetReport.cadence_note: Continuously updated database/portal with no discrete editions. The number is the renderer convention decided 2026-08-18 (HANDOFF section 7) and applied 2026-08-19: a nominal releases_per_year so that absence keeps meaning 'one-off instrument' only - 250 encodes business-day updating (the live corpus's daily-FX convention), 365 genuinely all-days monitoring. It is a statement of continuous flow for the pulse/beam system, not a claim of counted editions - the observed reality is in _cadence_evidence.
